node.title: Govern — policy, distributed context, provenance
node.summary: Central policy with distributed context, provenance/audit, and compensating controls (feature flags over hard blocks) — humans still review and merge.
node.interview_question: What in Govern is live versus roadmap, and how is a 'compensating control' more than a feature flag with a nicer name?

competitor.name: GitHub Copilot
competitor.positioning: GitHub native branch protection, rulesets, and Advanced Security already govern what merges; the platform incumbent argues governance lives in the SCM, not a layer above it.
